patch.objective: Preparing data for ML feature engineering, training, and serving with BigQuery ML

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Data Engineer exam guide v4.2: Designing data processing systems (~22%), Ingesting and processing the data (~25%), Storing the data (~20%), Preparing and using data for analysis (~15%), Maintaining and automating data workloads (~18%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch of the PDF on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 3.1 'Planning for storage costs and performance'. The guide does not name partitioning or clustering. (read for this round by an earlier pass on 2026-11-17)

sources.cite: TensorFlow, 'Get started with TensorFlow Data Validation' (training-serving skew)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: skew between training and serving data is detected with a skew_comparator on the schema and validate_statistics(statistics=train_stats, schema=schema, serving_statistics=serving_stats); 'L-infinity norm will only detect skew for the categorical features ... specifying a jensen_shannon_divergence threshold ... would detect skew for both numeric and categorical features'; if skew is real 'further investigation is necessary as this could have a direct impact on model performance'. The platform's Model Monitoring alert text is an authored rendering.
